packageRules.description: Keep the Expo SDK and its pinned React Native runtime family in one atomic PR. separateMajorMinor:false forces an Expo SDK major bump to travel together with the react-native/reanimated/worklets/screens versions that SDK pins, instead of splitting into a major PR + a non-major PR (which produces an SDK/RN mismatch). After merge, run `npx expo install --check` to align with the SDK's bundledNativeModules.
See expo-react-native rule: Expo SDK + RN runtime stay in one atomic PR including majors.

typescript 7 is blocked repo-wide: typescript-eslint@8.71.1 (latest) peers typescript >=4.8.4 <6.1.0, and every template depends on it either directly (react-vite, electron-vite-react) or transitively (eslint-config-next, eslint-config-expo). Verified: ts 7 fails install with ERESOLVE in react-vite and electron-vite-react, and crashes eslint inside @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree (ts.Extension.Cjs) in the nextjs templates. Re-enable once typescript-eslint ships a release supporting TypeScript 7.

eslint 10 is blocked in the nextjs templates: @typescript-eslint/scope-manager@8.71.1, pulled in by eslint-config-next, does not implement the eslint 10 SourceCode scopeManager.addGlobals API despite declaring an eslint ^10.0.0 peer. Verified: 'eslint .' throws TypeError: scopeManager.addGlobals is not a function. react-vite and electron-vite-react run eslint 10 fine because they depend on typescript-eslint directly, so this hold is nextjs-only. Re-enable once eslint-config-next supports eslint 10.

vite 8 is blocked by electron-vite@5.0.0 (latest stable), which peers vite ^5.0.0 || ^6.0.0 || ^7.0.0 — verified ERESOLVE on install. @vitejs/plugin-react 6 requires vite ^8, so it is held together with vite. Re-enable once electron-vite 6 leaves beta.
